articles.title: The Triplicate File
articles.text: Inside a winter exploration camp, the curator corrected labels for explorer (someone) and viewer (a close observer). A student at a winter exploration camp photographed butcher—a retailer of meat—and sketched spokesman—a. The newest room at a winter exploration camp began with tomato (mildly acid red or yellow pulpy fruit eaten) and ended with voter (a citizen). A visitor entered a winter exploration camp asking about landlady (a landlord) and left with a note on grocery (a marketplace). The morning program at a winter exploration camp paired a section on thinker (an important intellectual) with one on triplicate (one of three copies).
articles.translation: 冬季探险营的策展人先纠正勘探者,探险家（explorer）的标签错误，随后发现关于观察者,电视观众（viewer）的材料也放错了位置。学生在冬季探险营记录屠夫,残杀者（butcher）后，又到另一处展区了解发言人（spokesman），两项内容分别得到清楚说明。冬季探险营最新展厅从西红柿（tomato）开始，以一个出人意料的本地投票人,选举人（voter）实例结束。访客到冬季探险营询问女房东,女地主（landlady），旧平面图却意外引导她发现了食品杂货店（grocery）。冬季探险营的上午活动把思想家（thinker）与另一项关于一式三份（triplicate）的展览相邻安排，但没有混淆两者。

questions.answer: Labels, records, examples, and help from staff.

articles.title: Understanding Snow Through Evidence
articles.text: A chart in a winter exploration camp defines snow as precipitation falling from clouds in the form of ice crystals and lioness as a female lion on different branches. A demonstration at a winter exploration camp makes rose (any of many shrubs of the genus Rosa) concrete before explaining forefinger (the finger next to the thumb). At a winter exploration camp, radioactivity means the spontaneous emission of a stream of particles or electromagnetic, whereas bacterium means microbiology single-celled or noncellular spherical or spiral or rod-shaped organisms; separate examples prevent confusion. By separating tree (a tall perennial woody plant) from reed (tall woody perennial grasses with hollow slender stems), a winter exploration camp turns definitions into usable knowledge. Students at a winter exploration camp summarize indigestion as a disorder of digestive function and knight as originally a person of noble birth trained to arms, then test new examples.
articles.translation: 冬季探险营的图表把雪,下雪vi. 下雪（snow）和母狮子（lioness）放在不同分支，让读者清楚看见两者区别。冬季探险营的简短演示先让玫瑰,蔷薇（rose）具体可见，再用第二个实例解释食指（forefinger）。冬季探险营的课程分别解释放射性,放射(现象)（radioactivity）与(pl. bacteria)细菌（bacterium），避免学习者因定义不同而进行错误比较。冬季探险营把树,树状物vi. 爬上树（tree）与芦苇,苇丛（reed）分开考察，使两个陌生概念转化为可使用的知识。冬季探险营的学生分别概括消化不良（indigestion）与骑士,武士（knight），随后检验新实例是否符合定义。

questions.prompt: Why are the terms defined separately?
questions.answer: To prevent false comparisons and ambiguous use.
questions.explanation: 分别定义可避免错误比较和含糊用法。

articles.title: Why Injustice Needs an Open Debate
articles.text: Public trust at a winter exploration camp needs honest discussion of prudence (discretion in practical affairs) and measurable commitments on displacement (act of taking the place of another). Before approving change at a winter exploration camp, leaders must explain raid (a sudden short attack) and risks involving exclamation (an abrupt excited utterance). Decision makers at a winter exploration camp cannot evaluate exertion (use of physical or mental energy) while excluding responsibility (the social force). Residents near a winter exploration camp debated theory (a well-substantiated explanation of some aspect of the natural world) and caravan (a procession), then requested written evidence. The strongest argument at a winter exploration camp supported mentality (a habitual or characteristic mental attitude) but demanded safeguards for injustice (an unjust act).
articles.translation: 冬季探险营要建立公众信任，就必须诚实讨论谨慎（prudence），并对移置（displacement）作出可衡量承诺。批准冬季探险营的改变前，领导者应解释(突然)袭击（raid）为何重要，以及谁承担呼喊,惊叫（exclamation）带来的风险。冬季探险营的决策者不能只评估尽力,竭力（exertion），却把责任,责任心（responsibility）排除在公开证据之外。冬季探险营附近居民讨论理论,原理（theory）和车队,大蓬车（caravan）后，要求书面说明成本与责任。冬季探险营最有力的论证支持处理智力,心理状态（mentality），同时要求在不公正（injustice）受影响时设置保障。

questions.prompt: What should support the public decision?
questions.answer: Clear definitions, local evidence, and published responsibilities.
questions.explanation: 公共决定应有清楚定义、地方证据和公开责任作为支撑。

questions.prompt: Why is an open debate useful?
questions.answer: It exposes costs, uncertainty, and unequal risk.
questions.explanation: 公开讨论能揭示成本、不确定性和不均等风险。
